shared_elements: horizontal registers/bands of repeated small motifs
justification: Both surfaces organise content into horizontal registers and include figures with a round disc-like element and rows of repeated small signs, but these are generic organisational devices. A shows a symmetrical scene of slender human figures in profile flanking a central rayed disc above dense lines of script signs, while B shows heavy-bodied quadrupeds, a bird and crouching animal figures in relief with no human-centred symmetry or writing; the repertoires, postures and stylistic conventions are unrelated.
